metadata.name: Indonesia Property Dataset — Extended
metadata.description: Comprehensive property dataset covering 38 provinces of Indonesia. 12 building types including new types: store, condo, mansion. Rich facilities, full specifications, complete location hierarchy. All transaction_type values normalised to 'sale' or 'rent'. Suitable for chatbot training, frontend portfolio, and backend import.
notes: building_type includes: store, condo, mansion (new additions)
specifications include PLN voltage options and PDAM water supply
